About me

I’m Angello, a software engineer and founder based in New Jersey. My path into technology started with a curiosity about people — from studying psychology in Peru to working in banking and building digital products.

That mix shapes how I work. I care about how an experience feels as much as how it functions: the small detail that makes an app easier, a community more welcoming, or a story more personal.

I founded Zelandaware to bring my own ideas to life. Today, my work spans mobile apps, web experiences, and projects like Peruanify and Hola Grandpa. Different ideas, the same instinct: make something that matters to someone.
